exam: 2023年6月 第3套 · 仔细阅读 P1
title: Team-building exercises have become popular for managers try…

sents.en: Team-building exercises have become popular for managers trying to increase organisational and team harmony and productivity.
sents.cn: 团队建设活动在管理者中间很流行，他们试图借此增进组织与团队的和谐、提高生产力。

sents.en: Unfortunately many employees resent compulsory bonding and often regard these exercises as a nuisance.
sents.cn: 遗憾的是，许多员工反感这种强制性的联谊，常常把这些活动视为一种烦扰。

sents.en: A paper published this week by University of Sydney researchers in Social Networks has reported participants' feelings about team-building interventions, revealing ethical implications in forcing employees to take part.
sents.cn: 悉尼大学的研究人员本周在《社交网络》期刊上发表的一篇论文，报告了参与者对团队建设干预的感受，揭示了强迫员工参加其中所蕴含的伦理问题。

sents.en: "Many people see team-building activities as a waste of time, so we decided to look in more depth at what's behind this," said the paper's lead researcher, Dr Peter Matous.
sents.cn: "许多人认为团队建设活动是浪费时间，所以我们决定更深入地探究这背后的原因，"该论文的首席研究员彼得∙马图斯博士说。

sents.en: Staff are relocated and office spaces redesigned.
sents.cn: 员工被调岗，办公空间被重新设计。

sents.en: All this is done with the aim of improving workplace efficiency, collaboration and cohesion.
sents.cn: 这一切的目的都是提高职场效率、协作与凝聚力。

sents.en: But does any of this work?" said Dr Matous.
sents.cn: 但这些真的有用吗？"马图斯博士说。

sents.en: The study found that team-building exercises which focused on the sharing of and intervening into personal attitudes and relationships between team members were considered too heavy-handed and intrusive, although the researchers say some degree of openness and vulnerability is often necessary to make deep, effective connections with colleagues.
sents.cn: 研究发现，那些着重于分享并干预团队成员个人态度与人际关系的团建活动，被认为过于生硬、太爱管闲事；不过研究人员也指出，一定程度的坦诚和自我暴露往往是与同事建立深入、有效联系所必需的。

sents.en: "Some participants were against team-building exercises because they were implicitly compulsory.
sents.cn: "一些参与者反对团建活动，因为它们是隐性强制的。

sents.en: They didn't welcome management's interest in their lives beyond their direct work performance," said Matous.
sents.cn: 管理层对他们直接工作表现之外的生活也感兴趣，这让他们不舒服，"马图斯说，"许多人不愿被强迫去寻开心或交朋友，尤其是在繁忙工作之外。

sents.en: "Many people don't want to be forced into having fun or making friends, especially not on top of their busy jobs.
sents.cn: 他们觉得管理层太过打探，或者太想控制他们的生活。

sents.en: They feel management is being too nosy or trying to control their lives too much."

In this study the researchers recommended a self-disclosure approach where participants were guided through a series of questions that allowed them to increasingly disclose personal information and values.
sents.cn: 在这项研究中，研究人员推荐了一种"自我表露"的方法：引导参与者回答一系列问题，让他们逐步透露个人信息与价值观。

sents.en: The method is well-tested and has been shown to increase interpersonal closeness.
sents.cn: 这一方法经过了充分检验，已被证明能增进人际亲密感。

sents.en: However, to be successful it must be voluntary.
sents.cn: 但要取得成功，它必须是自愿的。

sents.en: The researchers said there are numerous schools of thought that propose differing psychological methods for strengthening relationships.
sents.cn: 研究人员说，有许多思想流派提出了各种不同的巩固人际关系的心理学方法。

sents.en: "With caution, many relational methods to improve teams and organisations can be borrowed from other fields.
sents.cn: "只要谨慎行事，许多用于改善团队和组织的关系类方法都可以从其他领域借鉴过来。

sents.en: The question is how to apply them effectively to strengthen an entire collective, which is more than just the sum of individual relationships," said Dr Matous.
sents.cn: 问题在于如何有效地加以运用，去强化整个集体——它远不止是个体关系的简单相加，"马图斯博士说。
